notes.title: Minor Update: Microphone Support & QoL Fixes
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We've just rolled out a small update to address some of your feedback and add a new feature. Thank you for your continued support![/p][p]Here’s what’s new in this patch:[/p][p]New Feature: Microphone Support[/p][p]- We're excited to announce that microphone support has now been added to the game![/p][p]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/p][p]- The panel that appeared on the left side of the screen when taking a screenshot has been removed for a cleaner, more immersive experience.[/p][p]Bug Fixes[/p][p]- Addressed several minor issues to improve overall stability and performance.[/p][p]As always, please continue to share your feedback with us on the forums.[/p]

tags.feature: - We're excited to announce that microphone support has now been added to the game!

tags.bug: - Addressed several minor issues to improve overall stability and performance.
